rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI — a private, local personal AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems — while Ahmad heads hardware at Midjourney and is pioneering a new category of AI-native hardware devices beyond simple wearables. Steven's conviction that personal AI should be UI-first and private aligns directly with Ahmad's experience integrating generative AI deeply into novel hardware form factors (Vision Pro, Leap Motion), creating a natural opportunity to explore how next-gen AI hardware and brain-inspired agents could evolve together.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Ahmad Abbas — you're both betting on new form factors for consumer AI (Steven in software agents, Ahmad in hardware) and both believe integration with generative models, not bolt-on approaches, is the path forward.
